name: How can I prepare my home for an interior remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my home for an interior remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for an interior remodel involves clearing the work area of furniture, decor, and personal items. You might also need to temporarily disconnect utilities like water or electricity to certain zones. It's helpful to establish a dust barrier to protect unaffected areas and discuss access routes with your contractor. Consider designating a temporary living space if major areas like kitchens or bathrooms will be unusable for an extended period. For projects in areas like Eagle or Star, planning for pet and child safety is also an important part of home preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by clearing the work area, protecting unaffected zones from dust, and discussing access. Consider temporary living arrangements if needed.
